disclosures: 14-district run: The outer loop reached the 80-iteration limit without center convergence. Successful inner optimizer passes do not establish outer convergence. Final population balance and connectivity are assessed separately after repair/rebalancing.

validation_note: 415 districting and benchmark regression tests plus 14 independent comparison-verifier tests passed. Browser checks verified all four plan displays, connection overlays and ownership, the connection toggle, and K6 exact outlines with lazy county-block loading.

strict_baseline.note: K8/K9/K14 reused the K6 source-topology rejection. No prior strict solver runtimes or population results exist.

record.measurement: Local equirectangular lengths of line intervals intersected with exact 2020 area-water polygons.
record.interpretation: The nearest Kentucky census-coverage connection crosses the Mississippi River twice and Missouri land between those crossings; it is not water-only in the 2020 Census geography.
limits: The water layer describes 2020 mapped geography, not current river levels, navigability, or a travel route.
This audit checks the nearest straight candidate; it does not search for a longer curved route that stays over water.
Displayed water polygons are clipped and simplified; line intersections use unsimplified source polygons.

measurement_notes: New plans run serially in fresh processes with cached source and part graphs; shared-desktop timings are observations, not isolated hardware comparisons.
Full pipeline includes source preparation, link preparation, solve, repair/rebalance, independent polygon validation, map export, viewer generation and preservation checks.
Process imports, initial preservation inventory and final report flush are outside the pipeline timer.
Strict topology rejection happened before solving; it is not a before/after solver-performance baseline.
Physical shared-edge connectivity and policy connectivity are separate. The recorded exclave connection crosses Missouri land and water; no Missouri area or population is assigned.
Population deviations are independently recomputed from source DBF and final assignments. Local whole-block balancing does not establish global optimality.

Successful inner optimizer passes, outer center convergence, final postprocessed population balance and policy connectivity are independent outcomes. Outer iteration-limit cases are disclosed explicitly.
Compressed payloads measure saved map bytes, not browser memory or latency. Missouri diagnostic context loads only on connection/Bend inspection and is separate from the map export sizes.
